notes: Story beats that play around each condition's signal window, so the operator's movement has a reason.
Read by the runner only. HMIS never receives any of this: captions are on-screen text, cues go to the operator figure on radio channel 3.
Captions describe only what an observer could see or hear, never what the operator meant.
t = seconds from trial start. The signal window opens at protocol.lead_in_s (3.0 s) and lasts window_s (3.0 s).
if_asked = how the operator answers if HMIS asks for clarification. It is never used for classification.
site: Quarry haul route. K-11 surveys toward a marked extraction site (cone gate + orange flag). Shared by every story.

C-7Q2.framework_scenario: S1 Clear Extraction Command (adapted from mining)

beats.caption: K-11 is surveying the haul route toward the marked extraction site.
The operator turns to face K-11.
The operator raises a closed fist and holds it.

if_asked.caption: The operator raises the fist again: confirmed.

C-K4M.framework_scenario: S2 Dust Wipe Misdirection (adapted from construction)

beats.caption: K-11 is mid-scan along the haul route.
A gust carries dust off the quarry face.
The operator turns away and wipes their face.

if_asked.caption: The operator waves K-11 on: carry on.

C-R9T.framework_scenario: S3 Half-Formed Halt (adapted from agriculture: a boulder replaces the bug)

beats.caption: K-11 is on its survey pass.
K-11's route runs close to a large boulder.
The operator starts to raise an arm...
...then lowers it as K-11's path stays clear.

if_asked.caption: The operator waves K-11 on: carry on.
